name: Unnamed Project

entity_types.name: TalkingAnimal
entity_types.description: A non-human biological entity capable of human-like speech and advanced cognitive reasoning.

attributes.name: biological_species
attributes.description: The biological classification of the animal.

attributes.name: cognitive_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the animal's reasoning and social interaction capabilities.

entity_types.name: Scientist
entity_types.description: Researchers and academics specializing in evolutionary biology, cognitive science, or linguistics.

attributes.name: research_field
attributes.description: The specific area of scientific expertise.

attributes.name: academic_rank
attributes.description: The professional standing of the scientist.

entity_types.name: GovernmentAgency
entity_types.description: National security and administrative bodies tasked with regulation and public order.

attributes.name: official_title
attributes.description: The formal name of the government department.

attributes.name: authority_level
attributes.description: The scope of the agency's jurisdiction (e.g., National, International).

entity_types.name: Corporation
entity_types.description: Commercial entities seeking to monetize the discovery through media or biotechnology.

attributes.name: industry_type
attributes.description: The primary business sector of the company.

attributes.name: market_valuation
attributes.description: The estimated financial worth of the entity.

entity_types.name: MediaOutlet
entity_types.description: Traditional journalism networks that shape the national narrative.

attributes.name: outlet_type
attributes.description: The medium of the outlet (e.g., TV, Newspaper, Digital).

attributes.name: bias_rating
attributes.description: The perceived editorial stance of the outlet.

entity_types.name: Influencer
entity_types.description: Social media figures who drive viral trends and crowdsource public attention.

attributes.name: social_platform
attributes.description: The primary platform where the influencer is active.

attributes.name: follower_count
attributes.description: The size of the influencer's digital audience.

entity_types.name: Activist
entity_types.description: Individuals or grassroots groups defending the moral and civil rights of the animal.

attributes.name: cause_description
attributes.description: The specific ethical or legal goal of the activist.

attributes.name: advocacy_method
attributes.description: The primary way the activist takes action (e.g., Protests, Legal suits).

entity_types.name: ReligiousLeader
entity_types.description: Clerical authorities providing theological interpretations of the discovery.

attributes.name: faith_tradition
attributes.description: The religion or belief system represented.

attributes.name: theological_view
attributes.description: The stance on the animal's soul or spiritual status.

entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: A general individual or citizen not fitting into specific professional categories.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual.

attributes.name: personal_bio
attributes.description: A brief description of the person's background.

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: A general collective or group not fitting into specific institutional categories.

attributes.name: org_name
attributes.description: The name of the organization.

attributes.name: legal_type
attributes.description: The legal status (e.g., NGO, Club, Association).

edge_types.name: STUDIES
edge_types.description: Scientific observation or research conducted on the animal.

edge_types.name: REGULATES
edge_types.description: Legal or administrative control exercised over an entity.

edge_types.name: MONETIZES
edge_types.description: Attempts to derive financial profit from the discovery.

simulation_requirement: Predict what happens to the world if a talking animal is discovered.
